kurz: Freezer burn is dried-out patches: ice has evaporated straight out of the food.
bild_im_kopf: Like washing drying outside while frozen in winter: the ice disappears without melting.

ursachen.warum: Ice evaporates into the air and settles as frost in the bag ([[sublimation|sublimation]]).
fix: Press the air out of the bag or vacuum-seal it

ursachen.titel: Stored too long or temperature swings
ursachen.warum: Every swing drives out more moisture.
fix: Note the date, use within a few months

q1.frage: Was there a lot of air in the bag or container?
